releases.notes:
# Changed: Synergy 1.1.5-Beta.1

### Interface and controls

- Added spring animations to interface transitions, radial wheels and the ability HUD, with a client setting to reduce motion.
- The ability wheel supports tap-to-open/click-to-select and hold-to-aim/release-to-select. Both player wheels have mouse-driven tilt, animated highlights and paging. Players can move, jump, crouch and sprint while holding a wheel, and switch between ability and relationship wheels with the scroll wheel.
- Redesigned relationship and social panels with species-themed artwork, readable text and faction-colored labels. Panels fade in and out while the wheel moves between its central and side positions.
- Updated outpost management and creature inventories with vanilla-style frames, member lists, item slots and a clearer Work Cargo section.
- Notes, clipboards and disc-writing screens resize to fit their content, retaining readable text and visible buttons. Long documents can scroll without text spilling outside the panel.
- Updated the mod icon to the Silk Moth artwork.

### New species

- Added **Latex Silk Moth**, a four-armed forest species with natural spawns, a playable origin, a spawn egg and matching transfur syringes, flasks and arrows. **Spin Silk** consumes food energy to produce four string. Idle moths prefer safe light sources while avoiding fire, lava and lit campfires. Their origin dossier includes a Crisscross log note.
- Added **Latex Swordfish**, an open-ocean aquatic species with natural deep-ocean spawns, a playable origin, a spawn egg and matching transfur items. **Swordfish Rush** works underwater, costs food energy and launches at Riptide II speed, with a straight swimming pose, body rotation, particles and Riptide sound. Contact damage ignores half the target's armor. NPCs can repeat the rush on a four-second cooldown, and fatal rushes have their own death message. Corrected natural spawning without making Swordfish disproportionately common.
- Added male and female **Latex Muntjac**, belonging to the jungle population, with natural jungle spawns, playable origins, spawn eggs and matching transfur items. The synthesizer selects the sex of Muntjac transfur items.
- Milk Puddings and Feral Sharks remain wanderers rather than receiving provider, scout or guard jobs.

### Social interaction and games

- Idle latex creatures can interact with one another, exchange pats and emotes, and invite nearby non-hostile creatures to play. Personality affects their preferences, and familiar playmates are favored. Combat, work, rescue and player commands take priority.
- **Play together** can start a chase while retaining its hypnosis-practice and random friendly-hug outcomes. Crouch to chase or jump to run; the runner has a three-second head start. Players see a countdown, distance bar and remaining time. A player chaser catches their friend by getting close and right-clicking. Starting early ends the round; quickly pressing crouch three times leaves it.
- Chase games support land and aquatic creatures, including NPC pairs and underwater player games. Catches can end in a harmless short hug; unsuccessful chases lead to encouragement. Added separate settings for automatic interactions, chase games, catch hugs, game duration and automatic chase cooldown.
- Added **Friendly hug** mode to the player's existing grab ability, toggled by right-clicking its wheel option. It can hold humans, humanoid monsters, latex creatures and transformed players without damage, transfur, absorption or wrapping. Manual release and player escape remain available, and hostile targets retain their hostility. Forms without grabbing do not gain the ability.
- Friendly hugs include two pup carry styles and tailored poses for small feral forms, Feral Sharks, Milk Puddings and Headless Knights. Added matching arm movement for Swordfish and Muntjac forms.

# Changed: Synergy 1.1.4-hotfix.2

- Fixed player/wild outpost spacing ignoring server settings when establishing a player camp, inconsistent distance boundaries, and existing camps being rejected after spacing changes.
- Outpost gathering assignments now show each creature's target resources in the roster and main/backup work controls.
- Added a server setting to disable organic-transfur reversal after sleeping independently of other reversal methods.
- Added a server setting to disable the low-health ceasefire in fights between non-rival latex creatures, independently of bonded-companion safety.
- Fixed creatures continuing to attack or pursue a player during the transfur animation. The creature responsible now ends the completed conflict without erasing faction reputation.
- Fixed missing Dark latex NPCs and inert player-body duplicates after involuntary transfur death. Death leaves one independent NPC of the resulting species, without automatically assigning the player's name.
- Fixed friendly transfur being described as retaliation because of attacks on other creatures, concluded conflicts or unrelated pursuit assignments.
- Fixed successful transfur negotiation failing to unlock direct right-click interaction. Successful restoration now establishes an initial acquaintance with the negotiating creature.
- Fixed White latex coverings on ordinary blocks being ignored as home territory by Pure White adaptation.
- Fixed Pure White adaptation changing the original species or body. Away adaptation now reveals individual eyes on Pure White Wolves, pups, Cerberuses and Bloodcell Wolves, including players in Instinct mode. Cerberus heads can have distinct, stable eye colours and styles.
- Corrected the Pure White pup's eye position, including when turning its head.
- Fixed chosen spawn personalities being replaced by random traits, including Playful and Polite after reloading.
- Fixed Playful and Polite behavior traits being hidden in relationship information.
- Fixed alignment of the grab-escape QTE, contact-roster header controls and icons inside radial-wheel frames.
- Fixed ability-wheel icons disappearing or shifting outside their frames, including White latex forms.
- Fixed the camp-invitation wheel tooltip displaying untranslated keys.
- Fixed small creatures, including baby zombies, appearing near the carrier's feet instead of in its arms during a grab.
- Fixed the permanent-outcome escape warning displaying a translation key instead of its description.
- Added the bonded companion's death dimension and coordinates to death notifications, including notifications received after logging back in.
- Added the companion's localized species after its name in the latex sample tooltip.
- Fixed forced transfur bypassing Changed's Keep Conscious rule. With the rule disabled, involuntary transfur causes death instead of takeover; confirmed voluntary transfur and protective wrapping remain safe.
- Fixed quadrupedal armour duplication when human riders right-click leggings or boots, including Creative mode and full inventories.
- Fixed Diffusion Syringes creating an extra creature instead of separating the player from the original carrier, including borrowed takeover control and double-headed Yufeng wrapping.
- Fixed repeated firework boosts failing while wrapped by a flying companion, including Red Dragons.
- Fixed environmental transfur affecting players inside a takeover, including latex puddles and dropped syringes.
- Fixed following companions refusing to teleport while targeting distant or unreachable enemies.
- Corrected dialogue spelling, grammar, punctuation and placeholders, including community revisions and the latest updates from Goldfinder's PR #13.

# Changed: Synergy 1.1.4

### Native latex origins and TrueTransfur

- Restored Partial Dark Latex Wolf as a selectable starting origin. Partial Snow Leopard is also available with Changed Addon Plus when modded starting species are enabled.

# Changed: Synergy 1.1.4-hotfix

- Fixed unresolved introduction-dialogue placeholders after wheel gifting. Applied Goldfinder's English dialogue corrections from PR #12 and corrected additional scent-related typos.
- Restored Partial Dark Latex Wolf to starting-origin selection. Partial Snow Leopard is also available with Changed Addon Plus when modded starting species are enabled.
- Friendly arm holds now allow harmless WASD escape, retain escape progress and reliably clear expired or interrupted hugs without hurting or stunning the creature.
- Travel invitations can recall distant, loaded followers to a safe nearby position even when their current area is not ticking creature AI.
- Stasis-chamber modification, growth and absorption retain names, affection, friendship, bonds, camp assignments and carried work cargo across form changes.
- Improved emergency rescue when a companion is resting or the hostile grabber belongs to the same faction. Waiting orders and attack settings remain respected, and automatic wrapping requires unobstructed bodily contact.

- Added compatibility for JEI 15.70.0.221 screen rendering, keyboard/mouse input and item-display interactions, including clicking, dragging and releasing carried items. JEI remains optional.
- Fixed provisioner bulk trades producing unpaid goods when combat, grabbing or takeover interrupted a transaction. Invalid purchases are rejected before goods leave the result slot, and unused payment is returned when trading closes.
- Companions can navigate powered facility doors and briefly crouch under low frames when their body fits. Normal power and creature-access restrictions are preserved.
- Fixed "Invalid player data" disconnects when transformed players rejoin existing worlds. Saved forms and valid absorption-negotiation state are preserved.
- Fixed Superb Warfare suppressors being ignored by latex hearing. Suppressed shots have a shorter detection range and reduced alert reactions; nearby creatures can still hear them.
- Fixed organic latex retaining obsolete hostility after transforming a player, while preserving normal damage against valid transformed opponents.
- Applied the latest community Russian localization.

**Faction behavior:** This hotfix keeps the original hostility between Dark and White latex. The peaceful-competition rework is not included.


---

# Changed: Synergy 1.1.4

**TrueTransfur integration:** Changed: Synergy 1.1.4 pairs with **TrueTransfur 2.0.0** for native latex origins, roleplay and Instinct-mode social interactions. Backward compatibility with **1.0.1** is retained; the expanded Instinct features require 2.0.0. TrueTransfur remains optional for other Synergy features.

Thank you to everyone who tested the mod, reported problems and shared ideas after 1.1.3. Special thanks to Nic, Crossader and Sword for their dialogue and localization contributions, and to TrueTransfur's author for collaboration, testing and Russian localization!

### Native latex origins and TrueTransfur

*   Begin as a human or a native latex creature with TrueTransfur, including eligible juvenile and fusion forms. Supports TrueTransfur **2.0.0**, with backward compatibility for **1.0.1**; TrueTransfur remains optional for other Synergy features.
*   Native players belong to their species' faction, begin at Recognized standing and receive greetings from compatriots. Their origin, citizenship and permanent creature identity persist through death and rejoining.
*   Birth placement searches for safe territory suited to the chosen species, including previously unloaded terrain. If no suitable home is found, choose another species or approve a safe birthplace near world spawn.
*   The **Starting Origin Selection** gamerule controls this mode. While enabled, TrueTransfur's permanent-identity features apply only to native players; disabling it restores TrueTransfur's normal applicability. Ordinary Changed transformations remain intact under either policy.

releases.notes:
# Changed: Synergy 1.1.3

Thank you to everyone who tested the mod, reported problems, and shared ideas for this update. Special thanks to Nic, Crossader, and Sword for their dialogue contributions!

### Player outposts

- Players can establish an outpost around a bell, link storage and beds, invite trusted adult creatures, and assign residents, guards, suppliers, and a following crew.
- Suppliers gather resources suited to their species and faction and deliver them to the outpost. Residents can use linked beds, including hive pillows for latex bees.

### Takeover and combat

- Takeovers offer one chance to negotiate release. Friendly and confinement takeovers eventually release the player; aggression at Distrusted standing can end in a permanent merge, while Hostile punitive takeover can end in death.
- Ordinary confinement has its own dialogue, and a refused release request extends its timer. A configurable prone period follows waking from a failed escape.
- Escaping a grab no longer counts as an unprovoked attack or costs faction reputation. If another creature takes over a grabbed player, the earlier grab and its escape prompt end.
- Pursuit squads move at a normal pace. They can appear in any dimension by default; a setting can restrict them to the Overworld. Another option limits companion combat assistance to hostile monsters involved in the player's fight.
- Creature transfur method can be set to native, random, assimilation, absorption, or eligible takeover behavior.

### Companions and interactions

- Bonded rescue wrapping and organic emergency evacuation can be disabled. Aquatic friends can shelter players after drowning damage.
- Bonded companions' tolerance for same-faction kills depends on affection; their form-reversal option appears only for forms of the same faction.
- Patting different body areas can prompt different reactions, with an eight-second cooldown between body-part lines. Alpha creatures stop leaping after a grab and can settle onto the ground when resting together.
- Bonded companions drop equipped armor and weapons on death. Revived companions no longer regain items dropped on death; species using Synergy's fallback inventory now drop its stored items too.

### Trading, dialogue, and compatibility

- Exhausted trades can no longer be refreshed through Shift-click trading and reopening the screen.
- Bonded Changed Vanilla creatures no longer try to infect animals. Suppressed TaCZ and Superb Warfare shots no longer prompt gunshot dialogue.
- Updated Light- and Dark-faction dialogue and improved missing-line handling so untranslated keys do not appear as speech. Newer takeover and patting lines have also been rewritten in English and Chinese.
- Changed Addon's hazard suit again blocks assimilation while still allowing absorption.
- Fixed a game freeze when Exp009's thunder dash or an Alpha's leap is used during voluntary suiting.
- With TrueTransfur 1.0.1 installed, temporary companion wraps end without making the player permanently transfurred. Companions still refuse unsafe reversal of a genuinely permanent form with dedicated dialogue.

Thank you again to every tester, writer, translator, and player who sent feedback! Please include your mod list and latest.log when reporting a reproducible problem.

Thank you to everyone who tested the builds after 0.1.1, reported problems, shared ideas, and helped shape this update!

Special thanks to Nic for contributing the personality dialogue rewrite and to Crossader for contributing the special-mechanics dialogue rewrite. We also thank both of them for their localization work. This release includes contributed German and Spanish lines.

These are the player-facing changes since 0.1.1.

## Companions and relationships

- Revival now extends to bonded, non-organic latex creatures beyond dark latex. A fallen companion can leave an identity-bearing latex sample. Use it in the Latex Infuser with that species' recipe to make a syringe or flask, then transfur to help rebuild the companion.
- Repaired Dark Latex Masks now use Changed's original mask transfur behavior when worn, including gradual progress and a completed transformation.
- Completing a bonded companion revival now awards the **I'll Be Back** advancement.
- Added an optional Multiple Bonds setting. Voluntary transfur remains available even when an existing bond prevents a new one.
- Added Rest Together. Bonded companions can rest nearby or lead the player to a usable bed and sleep together at a walking pace while the player remains free to look around.
- Tamed juvenile pets keep their ordinary pet behavior and cannot use bonded-companion wrapping until they mature.
- Aquatic companions can now be told to Wait on Shore.
- Bonded companions may confine an owner who repeatedly kills members of their species, with personality-dependent responses.
- The relationship roster now supports left and right page navigation, shows last known locations, and allows confirmed relationship removal even when a creature is unloaded.
- Players can retrieve an equipped melee weapon from a friend or companion.

## Social interaction and transfur

- Patting now has smooth mouse-wheel speed control through both the H key and radial menu, speed-dependent reactions, and a third-person arm animation for players and Changed creatures. The arm raises and lowers smoothly.
- Before telepathy is unlocked, creatures use species-based vocalizations. Reptile-like species can chirp, tweet, or hiss according to their mood.
- Some aggressive creatures can be reasoned with without immediately becoming friendly. An appeal may make them hesitate, show mercy, or briefly lose their momentum.
- Negotiation's next-step suggestion can be hidden in settings. When shown, it can be mistaken; offering suitable food makes it more reliable.
- Added an optional setting to vary qualifying encounters between assimilation and absorption.
- Exoskeleton takeover now displays a scrolling status log beside the player view.
- Native fusion now takes priority when takeover or hostile grab behavior could otherwise interrupt it. Creatures keep a stable fusion approach through brief target changes instead of repeatedly restarting.

## Territories and communities

- Provisioners can establish outposts in suitable Changed ruins and other non-facility structures. Latex bees also have a hive-themed outpost inside their hive.
- Indoor and hive outposts now use physical orange piles. Orange leaves regrow after harvest; players can shear fruiting leaves for dropped oranges or take oranges from a pile by hand.
- Restored additional white and dark territory buildings and latex pools, and expanded the creatures that can appear in white territory.
- White-faction reputation protection now covers the appropriate white-latex environmental hazards. White-latex creatures merge into and emerge from valid surfaces within their territory, with updated liquid effects.
- Improved Badlands creature activity and navigation around laboratory tables. A client setting can remove Pure White visual overlays.
